rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making a decision or determining an outcome.

example.english: I still need to decide whether to go travelling tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我仲要決定聽日去唔去旅行。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 jiu3 kyut3 ding6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 m4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: Use this for solving or settling a problem, dispute, or contest rather than choosing an option.

example.english: We have to decide this matter today.
example.traditional: 我哋今日一定要解決呢件事。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 gin6 si6

rows.note: Use this causative pattern when something makes another person decide something.

example.english: This experience made me decide to change jobs.
example.traditional: 呢次經歷令我決定轉工。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 ging1 lik6 ling6 ngo5 kyut3 ding6 zyun2 gung1
